name: @mhdd_24/linkedin-mcp

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Resolve the current LinkedIn member from the OpenID Connect userinfo endpoint using an access token. Returns the member id (used as the author URN), display name, and email.

accessToken.description: LinkedIn OAuth access token. Optional if LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN is set.

tools.name: list_visibilities
tools.description: List valid post visibility values (e.g. PUBLIC, CONNECTIONS). Use these exact values for visibility in create_post.

accessToken.description: LinkedIn OAuth access token. Optional if LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN is set.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create a text share on LinkedIn. The author is resolved from userinfo (not from arguments). visibility is validated against the supported values. Returns the created post URN.

accessToken.description: LinkedIn OAuth access token. Optional if LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN is set.

text.description: The post body text. Up to 3000 characters.

visibility.description: Audience for the post, e.g. "PUBLIC" or "CONNECTIONS". Optional if DEFAULT_VISIBILITY env var is set.
